# Competitor & Alternative Pages Skill

Builds competitor comparison and alternative pages that rank for competitive search terms and genuinely help evaluators decide: four formats — singular alternative, plural alternatives, you-vs-competitor, competitor-vs-competitor — each with URL patterns, target keywords, full page structures (TL;DR, comparison tables, pricing breakdowns, who-each-is-best-for, migration path, switcher testimonials, CTA), plus honest-positioning principles (acknowledge competitor strengths, don't misrepresent features, say who shouldn't switch to you), a centralized competitor data file so updates propagate, and a research process built on real product use, current pricing and review mining. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: good comparison pages demand real homework — actual product sign-ups, up-to-date pricing, G2/Capterra/TrustRadius review mining, customer switch quotes — and they only keep ranking if you re-verify pricing and features (quarterly, plus a yearly full refresh); the skill sets honest expectations on AI answers, noting that self-ranked lists tend to earn citations rather than brand recommendations. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
